name: Tara Bennett-Goleman
reason: Too thin once the rules are applied, and her work leans on psychotherapy. Her own site (tarabennettgoleman.com) describes her as a psychotherapist whose approach draws on schema therapy, with workshops mostly for mental health professionals; her only recent programme, the Regenerative Connections workshop series with Daniel Goleman (regenerative-connections.com), lists 2024 dates only. That leaves two books (Emotional Alchemy, Mind Whispering) and blog posts, with no current offerings, no videos on her site and no published email (contact form on regenerative-connections.com). Owner may want to look again if new workshops are announced.
